fairness_framework.self_merge_rule: self_merge counted in raw rates; excluded from adjusted success
fairness_framework.prior_merges_rule: reputation/access — report OR with and without this control
fairness_framework.closed_unmerged_rule: not equated to Core rejection; split by close proxies
fairness_framework.quality_rule: author_prep_score = body + test paths only (no reviews/LOC/merge). size_substance_score is size-heavy — not quality. engagement_score = reviews received — process only. Canonical high author-prep band: score >= 0.65 (also report >= 0.5). Phase 2: path_risk_band, concept/approach ACK text flags, nontrivial test diff — ACK flags are received signals (not author prep). CI still unavailable.

bivariate.note: Raw rates include self-merges as successes — use bivariate_fair for peer-reviewed comparison.

bivariate_fair.reading: If peer_merge rates converge, the raw maintainer premium is largely self-merge privilege rather than outsider rejection on typical PRs.

peer_merge_outcome.note: Dependent variable = merged AND not self-merged
Dependent variable = merged AND not self-merged

outsider_segments.reading: Established and high-volume outsiders often approach maintainer raw merge rates on typical work; cold-start and large-LOC remain the exclusion zones.

score_definitions.author_prep_score: Body length bands + test-path touch only. No reviews/LOC/merge. High band >= 0.65; also report >= 0.5.
score_definitions.size_substance_score: Ex-outcome size/files substance — NOT quality. Descriptive only.
score_definitions.engagement_score: Reviews received — process only; not used for matching.
score_definitions.importance: Excluded from claims (keyword classifier over-tags critical).
score_definitions.concept_ack: Received concept/approach ACK text — process signal, not author prep.

high_size_substance_contrast.note: High substance ≈ larger PRs; outsider merge rates here often look worse — size exclusion, not 'low quality'.

interpretation: [all_time] raw maint/non=0.800/0.544; peer maint/non=0.594/0.543; cold=0.287; established=0.674; large≥2k closed non=0.0761904761904762; author-prep≥0.65 maint/non=0.7625322257232885/0.5874611150993061 (gap_pp=17.507111062398238). [from_2022] raw maint/non=0.819/0.507; peer maint/non=0.632/0.506; cold=0.161; established=0.686; large≥2k closed non=0.049586776859504134; author-prep≥0.65 maint/non=0.7794701986754967/0.5740740740740741 (gap_pp=20.539612460142266). Fair reading: self-merge drives most of the average-case raw gap; cold-start and large outsider PRs remain strongly disadvantaged; established outsiders do comparatively well on ordinary work; prior-merge controls absorb reputation and must not be the sole headline; author-prep matching (body+tests, no reviews) still shows an identity gap — size_substance is size-heavy and must not be read as quality.
